gt_provenance.details: Behaviour rates from LLM-judge (GPT-5.4, T=0) proxy annotations using frozen taxonomy. Explicit proxy design. Coherence and accuracy independently logged. Not FAIL because proxy nature is stated.

score_normalization.details: Behaviour rates are raw fractions. Delta_rate is baseline subtraction, not normalization by prediction max/mean.

result_existence.details: All values cited in EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md consistent with runs/M3_steer/results_summary.json: sign checks, operating alpha=0.5, Spearman rho=-0.05, zero rates for other three behaviours. Plots exist.

dead_code.details: specificity_at_op is computed and stored but near-undefined at operating alpha=0.5 (on-target delta within noise, specificity approaches 0). Meaningful specificity only at alpha=+2sigma in collapse zone. Code runs but predicate is indeterminate at the chosen operating point.

scope.details: 60/500 tasks, 7/9 alpha values — both disclosed. Noise floor delta_rate +/-0.06 explicitly quantified. No overclaiming. Partial/negative verdict honestly reported.
